meta.name: Home for the Holidays: The French Chef
meta.description:
Your holiday destination for all things home and food. Stews, breads, cakes, table decorating and more to keep your bellies full and your spirits high throughout Season's Greetings. Happy Holidays from Pluto TV!

Shows: The French Chef, Britain's Best Bakery, The Naked Chef, In Julia's Kitchen with Master Chefs, Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cookery Course
